description: Celestial event calendar: the exact UTC minute and unix timestamp of every solar and lunar eclipse, planetary station (retrograde / direct), lunation and separation between two dates, 1800-2200. E.g. {start: '2026-01-01', end: '2026-12-31', include: ['eclipse', 'station']}. A calendar of exact events between two dates: solar and lunar eclipses (type and magnitude), stations (retrograde / direct), new and full Moons and quarters, separations between planets at chosen angles, ecliptic longitudes crossing multiples of 30 degrees, equal / opposite declinations, and declinations passing the obliquity of the ecliptic. Geocentric or heliocentric. Each event has its UTC minute, a unix timestamp and a stable key. Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.25 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/astronomy/events (x402 or MPP); always paid, never a free call.

angles.description: Separation angles in degrees, 'all' or a list from [0, 30, 45, 60, 72, 90, 120, 135, 144, 150, 180]. Default: [0, 60, 90, 120, 180].

bodies.description: Planets searched. Default: Sun..Pluto (geo), Mercury..Pluto with Earth (helio).

end.description: Last UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 366 days after start (inclusive).

include.description: Event types. Default: all that apply to the perspective. 'separation': two bodies reach one of the 'angles'; 'longitude_crossing': a body's ecliptic longitude crosses a multiple of 30 degrees; 'declination': equal or opposite declinations; 'declination_beyond_obliquity': |declination| passes the obliquity of the ecliptic; 'station', 'lunation', 'eclipse'.

include_moon.description: Also the Moon's separations, longitude crossings and declination events (geocentric only; many more events).

perspective.description: 'geocentric' (default) or 'heliocentric'. Heliocentric gives separations and longitude crossings only (no stations, lunations or eclipses).

name: celestial_events

accepts.description: x402 offer only: the payment options (scheme, network, amount, asset, payTo, ...).

endpoint.description: The REST route that computed it, e.g. 'astronomy/rise-set'.

error.description: x402 offer only: why payment is required.

deterministic.description: Always true: same input, same result.

llm_used.description: Always false: no language model is involved.

payment.description: How this call was paid: protocol ('free' or 'none'), price and the free calls remaining.

reproducibility.description: How to reproduce and check this result.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical 'result'; check it with verify_result_hash.

resource.description: x402 offer only: the resource being paid for.

counts.description: Number of events of each type.

events.description: Events in time order, each with 'type' (eclipse, lunation, station, separation, longitude_crossing, declination, declination_beyond_obliquity), its details, 'exact_utc', unix 'timestamp' and a stable 'key'.

settings.description: Settings applied: date range, perspective, event types, bodies, separation angles, frame, longitude reference, precision and the eclipse method.

title: Celestial event calendar (eclipses, stations, lunations)
